verdict.rationale: Lorikeet ingests your knowledge base and help docs to train the agent, and its response guardrails screen agent output for grounding, with the option to block, rewrite or escalate. This covers the 'grounded in my own content' half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows answers citing or displaying which article or source they drew from. Missing for 10: source/article attribution shown alongside answers, independent or hands-on corroboration of grounding quality.
